biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.prevalence: CPS 1 in a majority of HNSCC including laryngeal SCC

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Keratinizing SCC; supraglottic, glottic, or subglottic origin
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Traditional SCC grading; glottic tumours often better differentiated

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable; similar to other UAT SCC

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Basal keratinocytes of laryngeal mucosa (supraglottic, glottic, or subglottic)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Keratinizing squamous; glottic tumours often better differentiated than supraglottic
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Verrucous variant maintains high-degree squamous differentiation with broad pushing borders and minimal metastatic potential
